card.name: The word of after trial or study
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after a noun like trial(s), study or tube that names a study or container, introducing what was studied or held.

modes.label: Trials of a drug
modes.description: "of" after "clinical trial(s)" leading into the drug or condition tested.
modes.example: Two large, controlled clinical trials<< of>> a COX-2 selective NSAID

modes.label: Studies of a topic
modes.description: "of" after "studies" introducing the subject of the research.
modes.example: were not even included in the recent studies<< of>> prevalence among youth in juvenile justice settings.

modes.label: Container of a product
modes.description: "of" after a container noun like tube, before the product.
modes.example: Things it may be good to have: - Tube<< of>> petroleum jelly or other lubricant -

card.writes: It mostly adds the word "of" and similar linking forms, so the next words name the subject.
card.plain: It fires on the word "of" after "trial" or "study", just before the thing that was tested.
